params.body:
**Triage proposal** (from the forwarded mail; change the labels if it is wrong)
Category: request  Priority: P3
Summary: The sources an author cites in posts and reports should be compared with the sources the pipeline already follows, and the new ones should land in a review queue of their own instead of being lost after the check.

When the posts of the external writer are checked, each named source is traced to a publisher's page and cited under the sentence (`bin/cite-sources.mjs`, source "Cited by the author"; the same for "Add a link" in the Studio). The publishers themselves are not looked at again: a publisher the pipeline does not follow yet stays a one-off citation, and nobody decides whether it should be read every day.

Asked:

- deduplicate: a cited publisher that is already a source (by site address or exact name) is left alone;
- a new one is placed automatically in a review queue, with a name of its own (the mail gives the name; it is in Portal);
- the editors review that queue and decide.

The pipeline already has most of this. `packages/core/source-list.mjs` reads a list into `sources` as `proposed` and inactive, deduplicates by `urlKey` and name, and records where a source came from in `listing`; a person starts the trial on the Sources page and admits it later (Standard, rules.source). The likely shape: when a citation is written, its publisher's site goes through the same plan as a source list, with the queue's name as its listing, and the Sources page can filter on that listing. A first fill can come from the about 250 citations verified on 15 October.

Open before building: whether the queue is only for this writer's work or for every author's citations, and whether reports count as well as posts.

Source: Portal mail:32.
params.title: Put sources cited by authors that the pipeline does not follow yet in a review queue
